title: Keban Dam
scope: The complete near-site Keban dam exterior, with its north rock-fill wedge, DSİ slope lettering, six crest gates, three concrete spillway lanes, eight mapped penstocks, twin lower outlet portals, and shore powerhouse and switchyard.
axis: +X south along the dam, -Z east toward the reservoir and +Z west toward the Euphrates tailwater. +Y up.
heightPolicy: Single 823.5 m reservoir datum from the standard Terrarium sample at local [−150, −430]. The crest, pipe supports, portal headwalls and chute toe use the signed map and local terrain shape. The illustrative tailwater is 133.5 m below this datum.
limitations: The main footprint and orientation follow retained exact way 28431893, while the penstocks, powerhouse, and downstream portal mouths use native PMTiles controls. Gate heights, pipe diameters, chute grade, portal crowns, and electrical equipment are visually interpreted. The modeled water levels are approximate; the gates show a static operating state.

nativeMap.basis: The reservoir lies east, on local negative Z. The arch-like concrete section and spillway occupy the southern side, and the DSI stone lettering and penstock fan are north of the spillway.

groundCutout.basis: Cut only the retained rock-fill wedge, occupied concrete wall and chute slab, exact power hall and two native outlet portal bores. Preserve adjacent land, switchyard grade, native paving and penstock terrain.

buildingCutout.basis: Replace only the native power hall footprint, source PMTiles feature 35184767833204.
